description: Design and write Particula aerosol simulations; use for scripts, notebooks, process selection, parameter sweeps, or translating a research question into a model.
name: particula-build

description: Analyze aerosol chamber experiments by linking fast bulk SOA yield searches with particle-resolved chemistry and microphysics. Use for joint fits to mass, counts, size spectra, composition or water uptake and for comparing deposition, dilution, mixing and coagulation.
name: particula-chamber-analysis

description: Diagnose Particula exceptions, incorrect results, version migrations or CPU/GPU mismatches; use for traceback analysis, API drift, conservation failures, or numerical instability.
name: particula-debug

description: Implement or refactor the Particula Python library, native data model, CPU processes, direct Warp kernels, or resident execution. Use for repository source changes, not for authoring a user simulation script.
name: particula-develop

description: Organize and maintain Particula guides, theory, topic navigation and docstrings in Astro/Starlight. Route creating or editing published worked examples to particula-examples. Not for unrelated document drafting or private study scripts.
name: particula-docs

description: Create or edit published Particula examples in docs with an adaptable scientific narrative, explanations for every code block, plots or process visuals, closing reflections, saved results and topic/navigation integration. Not for private study scripts, general guides or API docstrings.
name: particula-examples

description: Explain aerosol science and Particula APIs with authoritative sources; use for tutorials, feature questions, equations, units, or choosing a modeling approach.
name: particula-guide

description: Plan Particula repository features, maintenance, or research when a development plan or issue scope is requested; define code boundaries, scientific acceptance criteria, dependencies, and evidence. Not for designing an aerosol simulation study.
name: particula-plan

description: Discover precursor-compatible aerosol reaction networks by screening discrete pathways, fitting rates with automatic differentiation and testing candidates in CUDA chamber replays. Use for primary chemistry, product aging, cross-reactions, and evidence for competing mechanisms.
name: particula-reaction-discovery

description: Investigate and prepare a developer-facing GitHub issue for a researcher's suspected Particula bug, unexpected result, or perceived scientific error. Use for reporting concerns, not implementing fixes or submitting code PRs.
name: particula-report

description: Review Particula repository changes or prepare requested commits and PR descriptions, prioritizing scientific correctness, native API contracts, validation, and evidence. Use for review/publication preparation rather than routine simulation analysis.
name: particula-review

description: Execute local Particula simulations and parameter sweeps reproducibly; use when the user asks to run, simulate, compare scenarios, or save results.
name: particula-run

description: Set up and inspect a local Particula Python environment; use for installation, dependency problems, environment selection, or first-run verification.
name: particula-setup

description: Reproduce a published aerosol comparison and extend it with existing data and controlled Particula simulations. Use for process discovery, uncertainty analysis and finding-led literature reports.
name: particula-studies-literature

description: Write or run Particula repository tests, numerical parity and conservation checks, lint/type checks, or release validation; use to choose the correct package, example, infrastructure, or GPU suite.
name: particula-test

description: Design or revise a square scientific table-of-contents (TOC) figure or graphical abstract to accompany a study title. Use for small-format composition, scientific visual metaphors, accessible descriptions and print-ready export.
name: particula-toc
